The vampire rebel then [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to their speed, then regains their true form. If they can't fit in their current space when they return to their true form, they take 10 damage and are pushed to the nearest unoccupied space. > ⭐️ **Agonizing Bloodthirst** > > The vampire rebel has speed 10 while any creature within 10 squares of them is [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding).
